caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock centered on a plain, light beige background. The clock is composed of a rich brown wood with a wood grain texture visible throughout its tall rectangular structure. The base is sturdy with bracket feet, and the central section has a tall door with an arched top and a small metal keyhole. The upper section features a clock face with a circular dial showing Roman numerals and ornate hands, encased in a golden-yellow metallic color. Above the dial, there is a semi-circular window containing a small painted face. The hood of the clock has an arched top with wood finials and decorative urns at the ends, adding more detail to the woodwork. There are no additional objects or background elements, focusing attention solely on the grandfather clock.
title: Tall Clock
